title: CHOICE_REQUIRED: a step needs a decision only a person can make (E150)
description: The gateway's error envelope with code `choice-required` (status 409) and five fields: the question in words, two to eight literal choices, why a person must decide (the class and the rule), who answers (always the person the agent acts for) and the token an answer names. A choice's `fragment` is the literal part of the request that choosing it sends. The rules a schema cannot state without new keywords (ids c1..cN in order, a fragment's canonical size) are choice.py's `choice_problems`, which every reader runs beside this schema. The token's derivation, the answer route and the record of an answer are E151's.
